claim: Exact same-cell linkage yields 7.344M distinct phase cells across 73 screens and 9.996M reporter observations across 99 acquired reporter-screen assays; 52 reporter-specific targets define 1,604 endpoints.

ordering.screens: ascending distinct exact-linked phase-cell count; stable screen_id tie-break
ordering.assays: ascending exact-linked reporter observations; stable assay_key tie-break

inferential_unit: none; complete enumeration, not population inference
layout: three plots side by side at 183 x 30 mm; no native panel letter
endpoint_encoding: categorical endpoint count on x; reporter count on y
endpoint_marks: blue filled bars with darker outlines from zero; exact counts above bars
font: DejaVu Sans; editable embedded TrueType in PDF
